# MIDI to TD-3 — T-1.18 BETA

T-1.18 introduces the first Windows beta alongside the universal macOS version.

## Compatibility

- **macOS:** Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- **Windows 11 x64:** tested.
- **Windows 10 x64:** may work, but has not yet been tested.
- **Windows ARM64:** not currently supported.
- **32-bit Windows:** not supported.
- **Windows 7 and 8:** not supported.

## What's new

- First downloadable Windows `.exe` beta.
- A successful TD-3 identity and firmware response is now required before USB writing is enabled.
- Added stricter validation of pattern data before transmission.
- Written patterns continue to be read back and compared byte-for-byte before the app reports success.
- The destination-slot backup remains enabled by default but can still be disabled.
- Added a short experimental-risk reminder above the USB write action.
- Clarified which individual TD-3 slot is downloaded as a `.seq` backup.
- Clarified the workflow for loading and restoring a saved `.seq` pattern.
- Removed the unnecessary “You are running the latest beta version” message.
- The version indicator now turns red when a newer release is available.
- Improved text readability on Windows.

## Known limitation

Loading and restoring `.seq` files currently supports the established **146-byte TD-3 format**. Some TD-3-MO files exported by SynthTribe use a 152-byte format. Those files are not currently accepted because the purpose of the additional bytes has not yet been safely established.

This limitation does not prevent converting MIDI and transferring the resulting supported pattern to a detected TD-3-MO.

## macOS installation

This independent beta is not signed and notarized through Apple's paid Developer Program. macOS may therefore say that Apple could not verify the app is free of malware. This means Apple has not notarized the build; it does **not** mean macOS detected malware.

Follow the [complete macOS installation instructions](https://github.com/timefracture/midi-to-td3-downloads/blob/main/MACOS_INSTALLATION.md), including **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

The macOS DMG is universal and runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

## Windows installation

Download and run the Windows x64 `.exe` installer. Read the [complete Windows installation instructions](https://github.com/timefracture/midi-to-td3-downloads/blob/main/WINDOWS_INSTALLATION.md).

Windows SmartScreen may display a warning because this independent beta does not yet have a commercial Windows Authenticode certificate or established download reputation. Only approve an installer downloaded from the official timefracture repository and verify its published SHA-256 checksum.

## Beta updates

Update grace period: 14 days

When a newer official beta is published, this version remains usable for 14 days. After that period, installing the newer signed update is required.
